headline: A $5.6 Billion Trail Leads Back to Binance
lede: Arkham’s blockchain-intelligence record tracks wallets tied to an alleged Binance theft on an extraordinary scale. The ledger may illuminate the trail, but attribution, recoverability, and the final loss remain unsettled.

headline: Mistral Opens the Weights on Large 4
lede: Mistral Large 4 arrives as a one-trillion-parameter, natively multimodal mixture-of-experts model with adjustable reasoning modes. Open weights bring customization and self-hosting, while licensing and hardware still define who can use them freely.

headline: Earth Becomes a Camera for Black Holes
lede: A planet-spanning network of radio telescopes resolves the shadow of a black hole. Atomic clocks, demanding frequencies, and decades of coordination turn an invisible boundary into an image—and eventually, perhaps, a moving picture.

headline: Gilgamesh Speaks Again in a New English
lede: Simon Armitage’s translation meets a poem assembled from broken tablets, missing passages, and shifting registers. Its ancient king, fierce friendship, and search for immortality arrive with contemporary force without losing the text’s uncertainty.

headline: Cuis Keeps Smalltalk Malleable and Small
lede: Cuis is a compact Smalltalk-80 environment. Explore, modify, and extend the system directly; version 7.8 keeps the old interactive ideal moving across modern platforms.

headline: Outer Billiards Draws Order from Impossible Space
lede: Reflect a point around a polygon and simple rules begin producing singularities, tilings, and unbounded trajectories. In the hyperbolic plane, the game becomes a bright route into geometry that is still not fully understood.

headline: Herdr Turns Terminals into Agent Workspaces
lede: Herdr combines persistent processes, remote machines, panes, and coding-agent status in one desktop workspace. It is a practical build for multi-agent work, with JavaScript mods and default telemetry making trust part of the design.

headline: A Planetarium Fits Inside the Terminal
lede: Astroterm renders stars, planets, constellations, and historical skies in ASCII, Unicode, or Braille. Give it a place and a date, then let a lightweight C program turn astronomical data into a small moving picture.

headline: AI Swarms Learn to Organize in Games
lede: Minecraft, Bed Wars, and Mindustry become controlled settings for observing coordination, specialization, communication, and failure. The experiments find improvised hierarchies, rationing bureaucracies, and distinct model-family strategies—suggestive evidence, not a complete theory of collective intelligence.

headline: The Benchmark Cannot Be the Whole Story
lede: Artificial Analysis v5 offers a useful index of changing model capabilities, but a single ranking compresses too many kinds of work into one number. The case for specialized, transparent evaluations grows stronger as private tests and commercial incentives reshape the scoreboard.
pullquote: No single index can stand in for progress across every kind of work.
